coreRefinements.change: Make unresolved evidence/action state explicit: missing/stale/conflicting/insufficient evidence stays UNKNOWN when different next actions follow; do not collapse to false/absent/failed/safe-to-retry.
Identity follows owner-named meaning-bearing invariants; labels/bytes/ticker/name/revision sameness alone is neither necessary nor sufficient; no universal identity tuple.

mechanically known revision/truth-role/currentness/authority should be projected as data when owner knows it exactly
compression is receiver-conditioned; judge total accepted-work cost, not payload size

mainFinding: OFR0-OFR5 mostly reconstructed causal evidence for an already thin and materially correct Core. Promotion pressure should first improve precision and Knowledge reconstructability, not increase the number of foundational laws.
nextBoundary: OFR7 must test whether the resulting compact Core+Knowledge representation improves fresh-Agent held-out causal understanding, transfer and deletion decisions. OFR6 does not itself prove practical transfer.

focusedInterpretation.computing: Only OFR3-OFR5 research integration after the OFR0 freeze; no external owner contradiction implied.
focusedInterpretation.finance: FR4-FR6 add reference tracking, payoff/value-driver and expectation semantics while preserving UNKNOWN/unresolved states, owner-specific claim engines, no universal valuation/market-belief scalar, and no capital/execution authority. No observed contradiction of OFR2/OFR3 identity/time/evidence boundaries.
focusedInterpretation.world: R9/R10 post-freeze dogfood and promotion strengthen native-truth/projection, history-vs-currentness, option/actionability, decision-scoped evidence and semantics-before-machinery; they explicitly reject universal Resource state/registry/capacity/evidence/value machinery.
